Cells in this table containing data have been randomly adjusted to avoid the release of confidential data. Discrepancies may occur between sums of the component items and totals.
(a) See the methodology for definitions of sweetened beverages.
(b) Includes beverages reported as consumed on day prior to interview (Day 1).
(c) Sex recorded at birth refers to what was determined by sex characteristics observed at birth or infancy.
(d) 2023 data excludes very remote areas of Australia.
(e) Includes persons whose sex recorded at birth was another term (other than male or female).

(f) The method of collecting mixtures of soft drink and spirits has changed which affects comparability. In 2011–12 and 2023, all mixed spirits which include soft drink (including home prepared) were coded within sub-major group of Other alcoholic beverages (three digit food code: 295), whereas in 1995 only the prepackaged versions were coded within Other alcoholic beverages (three digit food code: 284), with all others being disaggregated into the soft drink and alcoholic spirit components. Once these differences have been taken into account, the proportion of persons who consumed soft drinks and flavoured mineral waters in 2023 changes from 23.8% to 24.8%, in 2011–12 from 29.1% to 30.4%, and in 1995 from 32.8% to 33.1%.
(g) Includes sugar-sweetened commercial ice tea (eight digit food code: 11103001). See the AUSNUT 2023 food and dietary supplement classification for further information.

(h) Includes intense-sweetened commercial ice tea (eight digit food code: 11103003) and kombucha (eight digit food code: 11103004). See the AUSNUT 2023 food and dietary supplement classification for further information.
(i) Includes sugar- and intense-sweetened electrolyte drinks for 2011–12 and 2023 but only sugar-sweetened electrolyte drinks for 1995.
(j) Includes sugar- and intense-sweetened energy drinks for 2011–12 and 2023 but only sugar-sweetened energy drinks for 1995.

(k) Includes fortified packaged water (five digit food code: 11803) and flavoured packaged water (five digit food code: 11804). See the AUSNUT 2023 food and dietary supplement classification for further information.
(l) Includes sugar- and intense-sweetened fruit and vegetable drinks for 2023, but only sugar-sweetened fruit and vegetable drinks for 2011–12 and 1995.
(m) Includes aloe vera juice (eight digit food code: 11302001). See the AUSNUT 2023 food and dietary supplement classification for further information.
